card.name: Astronomy text, space before counts
card.fires_on: The space token right before a number counting astronomical objects, such as planets, craters or stars, in popular astronomy writing. It also fires weakly on other words in astronomy passages.

modes.label: Space before a count
modes.description: A blank space token after 'more than' or 'for' just before a number of astronomical objects.
modes.example: More than<< >>750 planets outside the Solar System

modes.label: Other astronomy words
modes.description: Scattered words inside astronomy passages about the early universe, quasars or black holes.
modes.example: core sample" of the<< early>> universe.

card.writes: It promotes unit and measurement tokens like mm and cm, which fits a number being followed by a size or count word.
card.plain: It fires in space-science writing, most strongly on the gap just before a number of planets or stars.
